description: This file defines a Formatter class for text formatting, including indentation and wrapping, used within the Kubernetes project.

classes.name: Formatter
classes.description: A class for writing indented and wrapped text to an io.Writer.

classes.name: line
classes.description: A helper class for managing lines of text during wrapping.

methods.name: Formatter.Indent
methods.description: Creates a new Formatter with increased indentation.

methods.name: Formatter.Write
methods.description: Writes a string with current indentation, without wrapping.

methods.name: Formatter.WriteWrapped
methods.description: Writes a string with indentation and wraps text as needed.

methods.name: line.Add
methods.description: Adds a word to the line if it fits within the wrap limit.
